statement: The frozen H-HLLAG rule (Hyperliquid perp taker in the direction of a fast Binance USDT-M perp move that HL has not yet followed; 30-s time exit) is profitable on meme perps it was NOT developed on.
purpose: Cross-sectional out-of-sample check. If it passes, the forward paper test may add these coins to reach 50 trades faster. No parameter changes allowed.

frozen_rule.fill_and_fees: unchanged from hlanchor_lib: taker fill at first HL top-of-book snapshot with exchange ts >= decision+300 ms, excess over displayed top one spread worse, 4.5 bp taker each side, $1,000 units, max 2 units per coin

coin_selection_rule.candidate_set: Hyperliquid meme perps that have a Binance USDT-M perp counterpart, fixed list written before any download: DOGE/DOGEUSDT, kPEPE/1000PEPEUSDT, kSHIB/1000SHIBUSDT, kFLOKI/1000FLOKIUSDT, POPCAT/POPCATUSDT, MOODENG/MOODENGUSDT, PENGU/PENGUUSDT, TRUMP/TRUMPUSDT, SPX/SPXUSDT, PNUT/PNUTUSDT, GOAT/GOATUSDT, BRETT/BRETTUSDT, kNEIRO/NEIROUSDT, BOME/BOMEUSDT, TURBO/TURBOUSDT, MELANIA/MELANIAUSDT, USELESS/USELESSUSDT, minus the 4 development coins.
coin_selection_rule.liquidity_rule: Keep candidates with Hyperliquid 24h notional volume (dayNtlVlm, HL info metaAndAssetCtxs snapshot taken 2026-10-05T05:37Z, saved at data/raw/web/tardis/results/newcoins/hl_metaAndAssetCtxs_20261005T0537Z.json) >= $1.0M.
coin_selection_rule.size_gate: Disk/download budget: a coin is excluded if its Binance book_ticker raw csv.gz for the reference day 2025-10-01 exceeds 60 MB (that day's file is downloaded first and, if kept, used as validation data). DOGE measured 103.8 MB on 2025-10-01 -> EXCLUDED before any result was computed.
coin_selection_rule.budget_rule: Coins are processed in rank order, all days of a coin before the next coin. Total new raw download capped at 1.45 GB (including ~0.12 GB of sizing probes already spent); stop before a coin whose expected size would breach it, and stop if free disk < 2.5 GB. A coin is reported only if all its available days were downloaded; any coin cut by budget is listed as not tested. No results are computed until downloads finish.

data.source: Tardis.dev free first-of-month samples (no key): hyperliquid quotes + trades, binance-futures book_ticker; same extraction as scripts/research/hlanchor_fetch.py
data.missing_days: a coin-day with any of the 3 files unavailable (coin not yet listed) is skipped and listed in coverage

pass_rule.bar: repo bar per split: n >= 50 round trips, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without the top-3 trades > 0
pass_rule.applied_to: pooled across all tested new coins, separately on train days and on validation days
pass_rule.verdict: PASS only if both train and validation pooled results meet the bar. Per-coin results are reported but are not the test.
informational_only: +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip ($0.05 per $1,000 trade)

no_changes: No parameter, fee, fill-model or coin-list changes after this file is written.
